selection_criterion: Published model card: tuned gradient boosting; held-out test evaluation reported by the model authors
source: House Price (India), Juhi Bhojani dataset, cleaned and modeled by IAAC MaAI course team
source_license: Model MIT; underlying training data CDLA-Sharing-1.0
data_description: 49,968 cleaned asking-price listings from 81 Indian cities; listings dated through August 2023; flats only.
disclaimer: Reported by the published model authors, not independently re-evaluated in this deployment. Estimates are asking-price estimates, not verified transaction prices or professional valuations. Dataset is dated through 2023, city sampling is balanced rather than market-weighted, and locality/building age/construction quality are unavailable. Area is assumed to be gross area; carpet area is estimated at 80% of gross area. Property age is not a model feature. Floor input is interpreted as floor number; total building floors and unreported amenities are imputed by the model.
